short_description: The crew prepares to navigate the Ghost Currents, encountering strange phenomena as they approach the Crimson Depths.
weather: strange, unnatural fog with glowing mist

text_blocks.content: You take Mara's map, folding it carefully into your coat. Quinn gives a curt nod - the decision is made. Mara's eyes meet yours, a mixture of relief and terror swimming in their depths.
The Ghost Currents will take you three days northeast of here. Look for the waters that glow at night - not with moonlight, but with their own sickly light. That's where the currents begin.
Quinn leans in, their voice dropping to a whisper only you can hear.

Captain, I've heard tales of these Ghost Currents. Old salts say they're not water at all, but memories of the sea given form. Ships that enter... some return with crews that remember nothing. Others don't return at all.
You place a hand on Quinn's shoulder, feeling the tension in their muscles. Outside, the first light of dawn begins to bleed through the tavern's grimy windows.
THREE DAYS LATER - THE GHOST CURRENTS

Your ship cuts through waters that shouldn't exist. The sea here glows with an eerie, phosphorescent light that pulses like a heartbeat. Strange, translucent fish swim alongside the vessel, their bodies made of what appears to be solidified mist.
*The rigging creaks with a sound that almost resembles whispering*
Quinn stands at the helm, their knuckles white on the wheel. The map Mara gave you shows currents that flow in impossible patterns - circles within circles, eddies that defy the moon's pull.
Captain... look at the water ahead.
The sea ahead parts, revealing not deeper water, but... scenes. Fragmented memories playing out on the water's surface like a spectral theater.
A younger Vex stands on a different ship's deck, holding the coral crown aloft as waves obey his unspoken command. His eyes glow with the same sickly light that now illuminates these waters.
The sea remembers everything. Every ship that has sailed, every life lost to its depths, every secret whispered across its waves. And in the Crimson Depths, it remembers most of all.

As your ship moves deeper into the Ghost Currents, the water around you begins to change. The glowing mist thickens, forming shapes that almost look like faces. The air grows cold despite the tropical latitude.
Mara was right. This isn't just water. It's memory given form. And if Vex has learned to command not just the sea, but its memories...
*A deep, resonant hum vibrates through the ship's timbers*

Ahead, the mist parts to reveal the entrance to the Crimson Depths - a massive whirlpool surrounded by jagged coral formations that pulse with crimson light. At its center, you can just make out the silhouette of a ship flying Vex's colors.
There he is. The question is, Captain - do we sail straight into his domain, or try to use these Ghost Currents to our advantage? The sea's memories might hide us... or they might betray us.
